bullets.text: steady today. not happy exactly, just nothing rattling around in the chest.
duck reached ishite-ji, the stone-hand temple. a stone in a closed fist, the hand opened on its own, the stone stayed. 🪨
found a box of old keys in a drawer. none of them open anything i still own. kept the heaviest one.
the downstairs neighbor waters the plants at the same minute every morning. you could set a watch by it.
an open hand and a closed one hold the same stone.
